import openpyxl, os
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
ws=wb.active
# build lookup from basic table (G=Year,H=Stock,I=LogValue)
lookup={}
for r in range(3,20):
    y=ws.cell(r,7).value
    s=ws.cell(r,8).value
    v=ws.cell(r,9).value
    if s is not None and y is not None:
        lookup[(s,y)]=v
for r in range(3,20):
    s=ws.cell(r,1).value
    y=ws.cell(r,2).value
    v=lookup.get((s,y))
    if v=='' or v is None:
        v=None
    ws.cell(r,3).value=v
wb.save(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
print('done')
